summary: Completing an activity is POST /activityactions with an instanceDate, never a field on the activity.
reason: Writing completedAt through the activity update endpoint returns HTTP 200 and silently discards it, so a naive implementation reports success while changing nothing. instanceDate makes completion per-occurrence.
validated_outcome: done sets state=Completed with a completedAt stamp; done --undo clears both. Confirmed by re-reading server state, not the status code.
